glosses: mit einem Besen zu einem Haufen zusammenschieben (und dann entsorgen)

examples.text: Der Beamte fegte auf der Fahrbahn die Glassplitter zusammen.

translations.source_sense_description: mit einem Besen zu einem Haufen zusammenschieben (und dann entsorgen)

examples.text: I'll wash the floor after sweeping up.
We swept up the leaves which had blown into the shop.

glosses: To transport to shore by waves.

examples.text: The only thing that frees the country from this curse is a favorable wind; this blows them into the sea, where they drown and are swept up on the beach for days afterwards in great heaps

glosses: to overwhelm, to cause to become overly involved in.

examples.text: We got swept up in the excitement.
